description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs:1093-1109 — prune_policy_tree collects child_policies into a Vec<ObjectIdentifier> on every iteration of the outer loop (which walks from cert_depth down to 1). Since ObjectIdentifier is Copy, the collection is only needed because tree.retain() takes &mut self and the immutable borrow must be released. However the collect() is inside the loop body and re-allocates a fresh Vec on each depth level. This is O(depth * tree_size) allocations. The same result can be achieved by: (a) collecting child OIDs for all depths in a single pass before the loop, keyed by depth, or (b) using a two-pass retain-free approach. In practice chains are short (depth ≤ 10) so the impact is small, but the pattern of allocating inside every loop iteration to work around borrow checker limitations is non-idiomatic and should be restructured.
title: prune_policy_tree collects Vec<OID> inside inner loop
